basis: Reviewed 2.0 adapter separation; provider budget reviewed for 2.1 private-file preparation and publication (docs/roadmap-2.1.0.md). Other budgets unchanged. Core code budget raised to 2650 for the 3.0.0 runtime binding admission (Runtime Binding 1.0 RT-016 to RT-023: reserved-key grammars, rejection categories, result identity, envelope-level rejection), split into runtime_admission.rs. 3.0.0 request inactivity limit: core raised to 2800 code / 3800 physical lines (inactivity.rs, the shared clock), providers to 3900 / 4300 and S3 to 1550 / 1850 (watched.rs in each: body adapters that re-arm the clock frame by frame and the reqwest conversion object_store no longer does). The adapters are copied in S3 rather than shared through core because they implement http_body::Body, which must not cross the public API of plenora-storage-core. Contracts 2.0 adoption (plenora-contracts 3aec9f7): core raised to 2900 code / 3900 physical lines for the runtime result limit (RT-024: a success payload over the bound is resource_limit, never truncated, with the effects preserved), split into runtime_result_limit.rs; no new public surface. Decision of the maintainer of 2026-10-18.
